reply.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, describing the current state of things
notes: In Portuguese, 'usar' is the standard way to say 'to wear' for clothes, accessories, glasses, or perfume. Do not translate 'to wear' as 'vestir' in all cases; while 'vestir' focuses on the act of putting clothes on, 'usar' describes the state of having them on.

senses.definition: To have items of clothing, accessories, or personal items on your body.

examples.text: Eu gosto de usar camisas azuis.
examples.translation: I like to wear blue shirts.
examples.emotion: relaxed and conversational, stating a simple personal preference

senses.definition: To employ something to achieve a purpose or complete a task.

examples.text: Você pode usar meu computador para trabalhar.
examples.translation: You can use my computer to work.
examples.emotion: helpful and accommodating, offering a tool to someone else

definitions: To have items of clothing, accessories, or personal items on your body.
To employ something to achieve a purpose or complete a task.
